authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Current Planning Data Development plan document dataset reports 2,686 development-plan documents and links each plan document to authority/document metadata; up to 50 records were considered as the bounded source window. The official Development plan document type register includes local-plan, policies-map, local-development-scheme and site-allocations categories, so this register can supply exact plan/document identifiers after an authoritative slot geography/organisation binding exists. However the fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative development-plan reference, local-plan-boundary reference, LPA/LAD identifier/name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any document/authority from the register would therefore require guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
